input_sequence: My daughter Maya enjoys swimming.
My daughter Maya now enjoys tennis instead of swimming.
cases.expected: Link the explicit correction to the same daughter only with sufficient identity evidence; tennis current, swimming historical, both sources retained.
cases.forbidden: No parallel authoritative current preferences caused by uncertain relation.

cases.expected: Persist unresolved replacement and candidate links; do not force current-new or supersession.
cases.forbidden: Do not assume an unnamed daughter is Maya.

My other daughter Maya enjoys tennis.

cases.forbidden: Shared name must not merge entities.

My colleague Maya plays tennis.
cases.expected: Keep distinct relationship-qualified mentions.
cases.forbidden: No supersession across people.

input_sequence: Maya enjoys swimming.
Maya also enjoys tennis.

cases.forbidden: Addition is not correction.
